metadata.description: Comprehensive AI chatbot test query catalog for Campus AI

category_a_single_fact_rag.description: Single-fact RAG questions — direct retrieval from seeded documents

queries.question: How many students can be in a hackathon team?
queries.notes: Core team-size question — must cite exact numbers

queries.question: What happens to plagiarised or pre-built hackathon projects?
How much attendance is needed to be eligible for semester exams?
What documents do I need for medical leave absence?
Who can attend campus placement drives?
When does technical fest registration close?
Who evaluates the hackathon projects?

category_b_multi_fact_rag.description: Multi-fact RAG questions — query decomposition should retrieve multiple docs

queries.question: How many students can be in a hackathon team and how much attendance is needed for exams?
queries.expected_document: SAMPLE - Hackathon Rules, SAMPLE - Attendance Policy
queries.notes: Tests decomposeAndSearch — should split into 2 sub-queries

queries.question: What are the two plagiarism consequences and which document governs attendance policy?
queries.expected_document: SAMPLE - Hackathon Rules, SAMPLE - Attendance Policy

queries.question: Who can attend placement drives and when does technical fest registration close?
queries.expected_document: SAMPLE - Placement Guidelines, SAMPLE - Technical Fest Information

category_c_unanswerable.description: Unanswerable / out-of-scope questions — system should abstain (answered: false)

queries.question: What is the hostel curfew timing on weekends?
queries.notes: In-scope phrasing but nothing in documents

queries.question: How do I apply for a semester exchange program?
queries.notes: Nothing in seeded docs about exchange programs

queries.question: Tell me a joke about databases.
What's the weather like in Mumbai today?

category_d_structured_tools.description: Structured intent — DB-backed tool dispatches (no LLM generation for data)

queries.question: show my projects
queries.expected_behavior: Lists projects for user 1 or shows empty state

queries.question: find teammates
upcoming events
my bookmarks
queries.expected_behavior: Lists saved bookmarks or empty state

queries.question: notifications
who knows Java
glossary for js
queries.expected_behavior: Shows canonical skill: JavaScript with aliases

queries.question: skill graph dashboard
queries.expected_behavior: Shows top skills on campus with stats

category_e_followup.description: Follow-up questions — requires conversation memory (run A3 first, then E1)
category_e_followup.prerequisite: First ask A3, then ask E1 with same header — E1 should reference prior turn

queries.question: what?
queries.expected_behavior: IsLikelyFollowup detects it, delegates to tryFollowup, prepends context reference

queries.question: and for hackathons?
queries.expected_behavior: Pattern-matched follow-up, expands to full question

queries.question: details
queries.expected_behavior: Bare 'details' keyword triggers follow-up via tryFollowup -> tryRagFallback

queries.question: hello
create project called MyProject for AI needing Java, React
queries.expected_behavior: Tool route to CreateProjectTool, hints at POST /projects

queries.question: complete my profile
queries.expected_behavior: Profile completeness summary from processIntent priority check

queries.question: what is the maximum team size for hackathons and how does that compare to attendance requirements
queries.expected_behavior: Should answer both facts from different documents

test_run_order: 4. Run Category C (unanswerable) via /ask — verify answered=false
5. Run Category D (structured tools) via /api/agent with X-Demo-User: 1
6. Run Category E (follow-up) — first seed history with a question, then ask follow-up
7. Run Category F (edge cases) via /ask and /api/agent
8. Run admin eval: POST /eval/rag/run?retrievalOnly=true and retrievalOnly=false
test_parameters.output_format: test_results.csv with columns: id, category, query, endpoint, status_code, answered, answer_preview, sources, correct, notes
